articles.title: SpaceX Successfully Catches Starship Spacecraft With Giant Launch Tower Arms For First Time
articles.description: SpaceX achieved a major milestone in its Starship programme as the spacecraft's upper stage returned from orbit and was caught by giant mechanical 'chopstick' arms at the company's Starbase facility in Texas. Starship completed a 22-and-a-half-hour orbital flight, circling Earth 14 times and deploying 26 Starlink satellites before its historic recovery. The mission marked the first successful tower catch of a Starship upper stage, although the Super Heavy booster experienced a navigation problem during its return and later exploded over the Gulf of Mexico.
